machine: MacBook Air (fanless), Apple M4, 10 cores, 32 GB, on mains power
engine: StarRocks 4.1.6 all-in-one container (starrocks/allin1-ubuntu:4.1.6) in a Colima VM, 10 vCPU, 24 GB
data: SF100 mixed snapshot (v1), copied into the container; read with FILES() and written with INSERT INTO FILES as file:// paths inside the container (run_starrocks.py --container-data)
protocol: Each run after 150 s idle, as for the other laptop runs. Output of run 1 verified identical to DuckDB's rebuild.
note: The DuckDB reference run afterwards took 32.7 s: not a benchmark number (no cool-down, the VM still holding memory); the cooled laptop DuckDB rebuild is 25.2 s.
